title: Lazy Sunday Bowl
description: A hearty and comforting bowl filled with the flavors of Venezuela, perfect for a relaxing Sunday morning.
instructions: Cook the rice according to the package instructions.
In a separate pan, heat the olive oil over medium heat. Add the sliced jalapeño and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Add the cooked black beans, chopped cilantro, and a squeeze of lime juice to the pan. Stir to combine.
In a bowl, scramble the eggs and set aside.
To assemble the bowl, place a scoop of cooked rice in the bottom, followed by a scoop of the bean and cilantro mixture.
Add the scrambled eggs on top, followed by sliced avocado.
Place 1 or 2 umeboshi plums on top of the eggs.
Season with salt to taste, and serve immediately.
